_comment: Copy to continuity.json and edit. REQUIRED EDITS: set 'workspace' to an ABSOLUTE path (the hook refuses the placeholder, a nonexistent path, and a relative one), and make the file list match files that actually exist — configured files that are missing are a visible error, not a silent skip. Sections render in config order, each under its own banner; a section with no 'events' key appears on every event. 'caps' feed check_limits.py at commit time (logical characters). This base config owns ONLY generic continuity — consumer packages (a scheduler, a tail-writer) add their own sections here when installed; see !SPECS.md for the section contract. No command/script source types exist, by design.

sections.text: Your session just started or compacted. **These files are NOT in your context — nothing was injected.** To maintain continuity, read them now, in this order. Reading these comes before beginning unrelated work; an urgent request from your human, an active correction, a safety issue, or an explicit pause/hold outranks this — handle it first, then come back and read.
